- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Cloud Backup Security Hint: Adds a hint on the sign-in screen explaining that signing in links your pet companion to cloud backup for session persistence. (why: Support received 8 emails reporting pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Live Activity Log Display: Displays real-time technical milestones and rendering activity status text during pet generation. (why: Wait info changes have won 3 of 4 tests on the home step, which currently has a 201s median wait time.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Control Overview Finish Flow: Replaces the finish screen layout with an interactive checklist guiding users through basic pet desktop shortcuts and hide controls. (why: Completion drops to 68.5% at finish, and support received multiple complaints about unclear post-onboarding pet controls.)
3: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Split Verification Layout: Reorganizes the adoption certificate step into a split column layout separating pet details from confirmation buttons. (why: Adoption step drops conversion down to 66.0% with a mean duration of 1017s.)
4: [finish, redesign] Finish Step Companion Desktop Quickstart Redesign: Redesigns the final intro screen into a stage layout with pet preview showcase and active launch trigger. (why: 395s median duration and 68.5% completion at finish show friction when completing onboarding.)
5: [choose_path, hint] Path Selection Account Persistence Safety Hint: Adds a hint clarifying that both pet selection paths (preset or custom) automatically sync with your signed-in account. (why: Choose path drops conversion to 78.3% with a high mean duration of 514s.)
6: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Session Restoration Alert Switch: Enables an explicit session restoration notification switch on the sign-in screen to confirm pet data protection. (why: Sign-in hints have a strong record of success (3 of 7 tests won), addressing 8 support tickets on missing pet data after login.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Interactive Stage Wait Indicator: Adds a continuous visual timer component and periodic status updates to the waiting screen. (why: Home wait time is 201s median, and previous wait_info changes won 3 of 4 tests.)
